title: Help in the chat: suggestions leave at the next message, a bare /help after the chat began asks back, one orange button stops Help first and the agent second, /help is a claimed token (answers carry a rating again since PR #1188)
steps: S1: Help controller: bare /help on the start screen, then a typed question; and bare /help, then a pressed suggestion.
S2: Help controller with a transcript shown: two bare /help.
S3: Help controller: an answer being written with two questions waiting, then the chat box stop (stopAll); then a new question.

S4: The plugin source and stylesheet: the row has no stop button; the composer seat conversation.input.activity holds the stop; dsh's disabled primary and every dsh stop (svg rect) are hidden beside it; /help declares a translated claim hint.
S5: Help controller restore and stream with a rated turn on the server (since PR #1188: the rating is kept and posted again).
S6: tracy-brand stylesheet against dsh's InputBar.module.css: hover, press and focus of the composer's round button and of Help's stop.
expect: S1: the suggestions row is removed; only the question row stays.
S2: two askBack rows (the person's /help and one sentence), no suggestions row, no request.

S3: streamingRowOf names the row while it streams and nothing after stop; the answer row is 'stopped' with the text that arrived; the waiting questions are 'stopped' and never sent; a later question is sent.
S4: every source test passes (the row has no stop button; since PR #1188 a finished answer carries dsh's action row, REG-PR-1188-answer-actions).
S5: since PR #1188 the answer id and rating come back on a restore and from the done event; a press posts POST /api/assistant/turns/:id/rating (REG-PR-1188-answer-actions).
S6: hover/press use --dsw-alias-button-primary-hover (darker terracotta), no blue info hover; focus is a 1px --ring outline with no box-shadow.
evidence: tasks/evidence/help-in-chat-2026-10-11/ (before/after screenshots on a real dsh page, measures in after-measures.txt)
fence: Help controller rows and the composer stop seat; the fork's claim of a text-taking command is covered by the fork's own tests (tracy.39)

tests: the suggestions row goes away once a question is typed
pressing a suggestion asks it and takes the suggestions away
once the chat has begun, a bare /help is answered like a chat message
streamingRowOf names the Help row being written
the stop of the chat box stops the answer being written
a Help row has no stop button of its own
the stop takes the seat of dsh primary
a bare /help after the chat began draws the person /help
/help claims its token in the chat box
hover and press of the round button use the darker terracotta
focus of the round button is one 1px terracotta stroke
rating: the answer id comes from done
